parts.title: The Missing Cap
parts.text: Oscar could not find his lucky red cap. He did not mean to **misplace** it, but it was gone. He felt **worried** because he needed it for the big game on Saturday. “Please do not **fret**,” said his friend Zuri. “We will find it.”

parts.title: The Search
parts.text: First they went back to the park to **retrace** Oscar's steps. Petra and Zuri helped him **scour** the whole playground, looking under every slide and bench. “Do not **overlook** any spot,” said Petra. Oscar began to feel **uneasy** as the sun sank lower. He had a **dread** that the cap was lost for good.

parts.title: Found!
parts.text: Then Petra spotted some small muddy paw prints. She followed the **track** to a bush by the fence. There was the red cap, tucked behind the leaves! Oscar's eyes grew **tearful**, but he was smiling. He felt **relieved** all the way down to his shoes. At last he could **reunite** with his lucky cap.

parts.title: A Better Plan
parts.text: Oscar thanked his friends for helping. He put the cap in his backpack, right next to his water bottle. A problem feels much smaller when good friends are there to help.
